value.rationale: A motivated published open torsion question for categorical cycle products requires comparing arbitrarily many colors. This general theorem bounds every fixed-degree integral torsion check to d+1 colors, gives explicit primitive persistence and nonnegative all-n binomial Betti polynomials, and works for any finite graph. Its nontrivial cone-vanishing lemma removes a potential high-color cross-effect; no all-degree result or guessed torsion-freeness is claimed.
